title: NexusRelay
summary: A self-hosted, multi-tenant LLM gateway: one stable OpenAI-compatible API, centralised provider access and model routing.
challenge: Give applications one stable OpenAI-compatible API while provider credentials, routing, budgets, rate limits and audit history live in one place.
decisions: Normalize every provider behind an adapter; clients only ever see a gateway model alias
PostgreSQL is the durable truth and Redis holds only disposable rate-limit and deny state
Money is integer nanos of an ISO 4217 currency — binary floating point is banned
Attempts are recorded before dispatch, so potentially billable work is never treated as unstarted
Fail closed: losing Redis stops finite limits, losing PostgreSQL stops untracked dispatch
ownership: Designed and built the gateway, routing and tenant model end to end.

callouts.text: Clients hold a NexusRelay key and a gateway model alias, never a provider key.
The gateway authenticates, applies organization policy and picks an eligible route.
Provider adapters translate the normalized request; OpenAI, Anthropic and Ollama are the verified targets.
Tokens and cost are attributed per attempt, in integer nanos, before the request closes.
